summary: Dependable, high-ownership Full-Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience engineering secure, performant web, mobile, and desktop applications. Proficient in modern frontend architectures (React, TypeScript), robust backend microservices (Python, FastAPI, Django, Node.js), and scalable databases (PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Redis). Recognized for extreme reliability, proactive cross-functional collaboration, and rapid learning agility—quickly mastering complex domain logic such as satellite telemetry, geospatial visualizations (Leaflet, Mapbox), and real-time streaming to deliver resilient, mission-critical systems.

Integrated asynchronous backend workers and WebSocket streaming channels for instant live updates and fault-tolerant data synchronization.
Collaborated closely with QA and infrastructure engineers to enforce strict JWT authentication, role-based permissions, and end-to-end payload encryption.
Architected and deployed custom full-stack web, mobile, and desktop solutions for enterprise and SME clients, maintaining 99.9% uptime across production releases.
Built dynamic geospatial mapping modules and coordinate tracking interfaces using Leaflet and Mapbox integrated with PostgreSQL and REST APIs.
Designed modular microservices and containerized workflows with Docker, accelerating deployment pipelines and ensuring reproducible environments.
Maintained comprehensive architectural diagrams, API documentation (Swagger/Postman), and automated CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless team maintenance.
Delivered scalable web and API platforms, integrating high-throughput database schemas with PostgreSQL and caching layers with Redis.
Engineered responsive, accessible front-end interfaces adhering to WCAG standards, improving user retention by 35%.
Implemented rigorous unit and integration testing suites to guarantee deterministic data processing and zero regression bugs.
